evidence.note: RELIEF shapes LRM reasoning behavior (efficiency, faithfulness) without ever showing the model a single reasoning trace, exploiting a probed 'latent reasoning belief' -- logit differences over self-descriptive tokens ('concise' vs. 'verbose') that correlate strongly with actual reasoning length (Spearman rho~-0.69) -- by fine-tuning only on synthesized, trace-free self-reflective QA pairs affirming a target belief; this shifts DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B's reasoning length to 71.4% of baseline while achieving the highest overall accuracy of all compared methods (including a much more compute-intensive SimPO baseline needing 10-20x more training tokens), and similarly improves faithfulness under adversarial hints, with logit re-probing confirming a genuine internal belief shift rather than superficial SFT format-imitation.
evidence.title: Finding RELIEF: Shaping Reasoning Behavior without Reasoning Supervision via Belief Engineering
